title: 1227 | Back-end Developer
description: Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is looking for a Back-end Developer to join our team. Long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required Our client is an international organization supporting global environmental and sustainability initiatives. The engagement focuses on developing and supporting enterprise applications, digital services, and technology solutions used across the organization. Specialists will collaborate with internal teams and external partners in an international environment, following established architecture, security, and delivery standards. We are looking for a Back-end Developer to develop and maintain enterprise backend applications, APIs, and system integrations. You will implement business logic and contribute to secure, reliable, and scalable services in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services using .NET, Python, Node.js, or equivalent technologies. Translate business requirements into application functionality, APIs, and integrations. Design and manage relational and/or NoSQL databases. Implement authentication, encryption, logging, monitoring, and caching. Develop automated unit tests, participate in code reviews, and troubleshoot defects. Maintain technical documentation and communicate implementation progress, dependencies, and issues. Requirements At least 5 years of experience developing and maintaining backend applications, including APIs, integrations, and service-based architectures. At least 5 years of experience working independently and within multidisciplinary teams across business functions, organizations, or locations. At least 3 years of experience using Jira in collaborative software delivery environments. Strong experience with one or more enterprise backend technologies, such as .NET, Python, or Node.js. Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, server-side security, reliability, and scalability. Experience with automated unit testing and software quality practices. Experience using AI-assisted development tools, with critical review of generated outputs. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field. At least one relevant professional certification, such as AZ-204, AWS Certified Developer – Associate, Oracle Certified Professional Java SE Developer, CKAD, or equivalent. Would be a plus: For university degrees, the awarding institution must rank among the top 500 in an overall or subject-specific university ranking Experience working with or for large organizations with complex structures and multiple business units Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
